projection.title: Garden rows
projection.prompt: A community garden has 8 tomato plants and 12 pepper plants. What is the ratio of tomato plants to pepper plants? Write the ratio in simplest form.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept colon, words, or fraction notation when the order is tomato to pepper.

projection.accessibilityNotes: Present the quantities in text and a labeled table; do not rely on color or spatial position alone.
projection.accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: There are 8 tomato plants and 12 pepper plants in a community garden. State the ratio of tomato plants to pepper plants in simplest form.

projection.title: Bicycle pace
projection.prompt: A cyclist travels 45 miles in 3 hours at a steady pace. What is the unit rate in miles per hour?
projection.accessibilityNotes: Read units aloud in the prompt and keep the division expression available as selectable text.
projection.accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: A cyclist travels 45 miles in 3 hours at a steady pace. Find the unit rate by determining how many miles are traveled in 1 hour.

projection.title: Paint mixtures
projection.prompt: A paint mixture uses 2 cups of blue paint for every 5 cups of white paint. Complete the table: blue cups 2, 4, 6; white cups 5, __, __.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept the two missing white-paint values in left-to-right order.

projection.accessibilityNotes: Render the table with explicit row and column headers and provide a linear text version for screen readers.
projection.accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: A paint mixture has a ratio of 2 cups of blue paint to 5 cups of white paint. Complete the white-paint entries that match blue amounts of 4 cups and 6 cups.
